test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options best summarises the given passage?

options.text: Farm fires have been halted successfully due to the coordination between AAP and BJP.
A mix of technology, government funds and a sense of political responsibility helps solve difficult problems.
There are no political dimensions in dealing with intractable problems.
Farmers' difficulties have been reduced to zero per cent by agriculture scientists.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage highlights **that a mix of technology, government-backed incentives, political responsibility, and funds has contributed to a substantial reduction in farm fires.**
 
• It also suggests that such an **approach **can address even seemingly intractable problems, beyond just the issue of farm fires.
 
• **Option 2 **best captures this overarching idea, summarizing the essence of the passage.
 
• The other options either misrepresent details or do not encapsulate the main point of the passage effectively.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2: A mix of technology, government funds and a sense of political responsibility helps solve difficult problems.**
